id.description: persistent UUID; derived from ns:name when omitted

collisionShape.description: collision shape (item 2): none = not solid, cross = thin hitbox (physics milestone); none wins over collidable:true

selectionShape.description: selection/pick-box shape (item 2): feeds the editor milestone

builtinId.description: unsupported today: the builtin table occupies every id in 0..50, so any declared mapping is refused; author catalog-only blocks (omit builtin_id)

color.description: [r, g, b(, a)] 0..1 — base color (also the fallback for unset faces)

faceTop.description: [r, g, b(, a)] 0..1 — color of the +Y face (overrides color)

faceBottom.description: [r, g, b(, a)] 0..1 — color of the -Y face (overrides color)

faceSide.description: [r, g, b(, a)] 0..1 — color of horizontal faces (overrides color)

occlusion.description: false draws faces even against opaque neighbors (fences/plants)

states.description: named states (FALTANTES item 5): [{ name, color, face_top?, face_side?, face_bottom?, light_emission? }]; states[0] = default state

transitions.description: versioned transition rules (FALTANTES item 5): [{ from, to, trigger }]; "" = default state

fluid.description: inline fluid binding (FALTANTES item 7): the block drives this fluid directly, no separate fluid asset needed — { viscosity, density, range, tick_interval, source, falling, evaporation, damage_per_tick, compressible }

soundPlace.description: namespaced sound id for placing the block (item 4)

soundBreak.description: namespaced sound id for breaking the block (item 4)

soundStep.description: namespaced sound id for stepping on the block (item 4)

soundHit.description: namespaced sound id for hitting the block (item 4)

particleBreak.description: namespaced particle id emitted when the block breaks (item 4)

flammability.description: heat/explosion ignition axis in 0..1 — explosions burn blocks with flammability > 0 (item 10)

behaviorId.description: declarative behavior reference (item 6): namespaced id (ns:name) or empty
